tooltip: Scans the item registry for every sapling/fungus/propagule/azalea item that grows into a tree (any block extending SaplingBlock, which covers vanilla saplings and most modded tree saplings too, plus the handful of vanilla growers that don't: mangrove propagule, azalea, flowering azalea, crimson/warped fungus). Returns a list of one-count item stacks you can loop over to batch-run grow/capture. Not included: bamboo and other continuously-growing (non discrete-tree) blocks, and any modded sapling that doesn't extend SaplingBlock.
